data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata and short assistant-generated Chinese summaries
data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Downloading and public visibility do not establish a redistribution license. No full descriptions, videos, game code or other game assets stored.

scope.sampling_rule: Up to the first 10 games in the visible homepage 热门免费游戏 numbered list; the rendered list explicitly contains only 5, all retained. Inspect the first 5 linked details. No filler games added.
scope.section_definition_raw: 根据实时游玩热度统计，这些是 Poki 上目前最热门的 5 大当红游戏 。
scope.position_semantics: Explicit numbered position in the homepage 热门免费游戏 list; source-claimed real-time play popularity without disclosed formula. Not an independently verified global rank, and not interchangeable with detail-page popularity rank.

source_extensions.detail_navigation_note: Five unique linked details inspected after the scheduled start. Four cover image documents subsequently opened using exact freshly observed currentSrc URLs solely to recover timed-out downloads. No gameplay inputs, voting, authentication, or hidden APIs used.

limitations: Bounded public UI sample, not a complete catalog or independently verified heat score.
Homepage numbered positions and detail popularity ranks are separate displays and may disagree.
Likes/dislikes are rounded source abbreviations. Votes are not plays, unique users or concurrency.
Date labels retain month-level precision; no exact release date invented.
Online labels, if present, are source display lower bounds with unspecified population and observation window, not verified CCU. None observed in this batch.
Subway Surfers detail page title shows 404未找到结果; HTTP response status is not exposed. This is not a permanent delisting claim.
Game frames may auto-load on detail visits; no gameplay inputs, voting, login or hidden APIs used.

Cover downloads initially timed out on detail-page responsive images; exact observed image document URLs then downloaded successfully. Actual decoded bytes are PNG, regardless of historical AVIF variants.
Short-interval source changes may reflect display or cache differences; no growth or popularity velocity inferred.
